// @camis:generated — do not edit; regenerated by camis
import { Router, type Request } from "express";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { db } from "../db/client";
import { notes } from "../db/schema";
import {
  assignOwners,
  authorizeAction,
  filterRead,
  keepOwners,
  recordAllowed,
  roleOf,
  sortColumn,
  stripWrites,
} from "../permissions/enforce";
import { checkLinks, dropLinks, linkColumns, readLinks, writeLinks, type Allowed } from "../morphs";

function pick(obj: Record<string, unknown>, keys: string[]): Record<string, unknown> {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const k of keys) if (k in obj) out[k] = obj[k];
  return out;
}

// A link names an entry the caller may read: its type's read grant, and its record condition.
const allowed =
  (req: Request): Allowed =>
  (type, row) =>
    authorizeAction(roleOf(req), type, "read") && recordAllowed(req, type, "read", row);

const view = (req: Request, row: Record<string, unknown>) =>
  filterRead(req, "Note", readLinks("Note", row, allowed(req)));

export const notesRouter = Router();

notesRouter.get("/", (req, res) => {
  if (!authorizeAction(roleOf(req), "Note", "read")) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "forbidden" });
    return;
  }
  const all = db.select().from(notes).all().filter((row) => recordAllowed(req, "Note", "read", row));
  const sort = sortColumn(req, "Note", req.query._sort);
  const order = String(req.query._order ?? "ASC").toUpperCase() === "DESC" ? -1 : 1;
  all.sort((a, b) => (a[sort as keyof typeof a] > b[sort as keyof typeof b] ? order : -order));
  const start = Number(req.query._start ?? 0);
  const end = Number(req.query._end ?? all.length);
  const page = all.slice(start, end).map((row) => view(req, row));
  res.setHeader("Content-Range", `notes ${start}-${Math.max(start, end - 1)}/${all.length}`);
  res.json(page);
});

notesRouter.get("/:id", (req, res) => {
  if (!authorizeAction(roleOf(req), "Note", "read")) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "forbidden" });
    return;
  }
  const row = db.select().from(notes).where(eq(notes.id, Number(req.params.id))).get();
  if (!row || !recordAllowed(req, "Note", "read", row)) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  res.json(view(req, row));
});

notesRouter.post("/", (req, res) => {
  if (!authorizeAction(roleOf(req), "Note", "create")) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "forbidden" });
    return;
  }
  const proposed = pick(req.body, ["title", "subjects", "pinned_to"]);
  const permitted = assignOwners(req, "Note", stripWrites(req, "Note", proposed, proposed));
  const refused = checkLinks("Note", permitted, allowed(req));
  if (refused !== null) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: refused });
    return;
  }
  const data = linkColumns("Note", permitted);
  if (!recordAllowed(req, "Note", "create", data)) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "forbidden" });
    return;
  }
  const row = db.insert(notes).values(data).returning().get();
  writeLinks("Note", row.id, permitted);
  res.status(201).json(view(req, row));
});

notesRouter.patch("/:id", (req, res) => {
  if (!authorizeAction(roleOf(req), "Note", "update")) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "forbidden" });
    return;
  }
  const existing = db.select().from(notes).where(eq(notes.id, Number(req.params.id))).get();
  if (!existing || !recordAllowed(req, "Note", "update", existing)) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  const incoming = keepOwners(req, "Note", pick(req.body, ["title", "subjects", "pinned_to"]));
  const permitted = stripWrites(req, "Note", { ...existing, ...incoming }, incoming);
  const refused = checkLinks("Note", permitted, allowed(req));
  if (refused !== null) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: refused });
    return;
  }
  const data = linkColumns("Note", permitted);
  if (!recordAllowed(req, "Note", "update", { ...existing, ...data })) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "forbidden" });
    return;
  }
  const row =
    Object.keys(data).length > 0
      ? db.update(notes).set(data).where(eq(notes.id, Number(req.params.id))).returning().get()
      : existing;
  writeLinks("Note", row.id, permitted);
  res.json(view(req, row));
});

notesRouter.delete("/:id", (req, res) => {
  if (!authorizeAction(roleOf(req), "Note", "delete")) {
    res.status(403).json({ error: "forbidden" });
    return;
  }
  const existing = db.select().from(notes).where(eq(notes.id, Number(req.params.id))).get();
  if (!existing || !recordAllowed(req, "Note", "delete", existing)) {
    res.status(404).json({ error: "not found" });
    return;
  }
  dropLinks("Note", Number(req.params.id));
  db.delete(notes).where(eq(notes.id, Number(req.params.id))).run();
  res.json({ id: Number(req.params.id) });
});
